notes.title: 🏅 Your achievements ready, Captain!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429109/3eaf7e34d8f24960aebc5d8c163ae2b15742579d.png[/img]

Captain! We've prepared achievements to commemorate your victories and setbacks on your journey into the Unknown. Every small achievement is a stepping stone toward mankind's great triumph!

May your courage carry you through the Unknown! 🫡

notes.title: All systems go, we’re just waiting on the coffee to brew! 🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429109/4052fe602429558e77326bc355623591860d41e1.png[/img]

Once you’ve gathered at least one of each module, you’re ready to make the jump. The distance you can travel and the success of your journey depend on the number of engines you've constructed, the amount of fuel you’ve gathered, and how much energy you’re generating.

Prepare for the ultimate leap into the unknown. As a pioneer of a distant star system, your mission will be to establish a settlement, using the materials and human resources you've assembled around the Sun.

The stars are waiting, Captain!

notes.title: 🚀Stay safe in the cosmic playground – shields on, always!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429109/1ac66ce9b349f026055a16bb07dbd660dd82f8a4.png[/img]

The [b]magnetic field[/b] [[b]MFLD[/b]] provides reliable protection against [b]Solar flare[/b], ensuring the functionality of [b]Solar panels[/b] [[b]SPNL[/b]], [b]Fuel tanks[/b] [[b]FUEL[/b]] and [b]Interstellar Drive Engines[/b] [[b]IDEN[/b]] after star radiation.

May your courage guide you through the Unknown. 🫡

notes.title: 🚀 Remember, kids: shield up for inner system flights (and beyond)!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429109/0eec8d0fc0e82463c73845b8e1d62b9c40588cae.png[/img]

The [b]Kinetic shield[/b] [[b]KSHD[/b]] protects the ship from Micrometeoroids cloud that could damage [b]Supplies[/b] [[b]SUPP[/b]] and [b]Living modules[/b] [[b]LMOD[/b]] during travel within a star system or an interstellar flight.
It is a safety measure that ensures the ship's structural integrity and the success of the mission.

May your courage guide you through the Unknown! 🫡
